For each of the twelve B001 comparisons, the New Testament side of the comparison is TEXT_PRESENT in The Greek New Testament: SBL Edition
1
more_horiz
. Because this work is a critical edition rather than an exegetical commentary, the printed Greek text and its textual apparatus constitute the primary evidence
1
more_horiz
.
1. B001-1: Romans 4:3 / Genesis 15:6
Status: TEXT_PRESENT
1
.
Exact Passage / Reference: Πρὸς Ῥωμαίους (Romans) 4:3
1
.
Exact Printed Text: τί γὰρ ἡ γραφὴ λέγει; Ἐπίστευσεν δὲ Ἀβραὰμ τῷ θεῷ καὶ ἐλογίσθη αὐτῷ εἰς δικαιοσύνην.
1
Printed Page / Locator: Page 317
11
.
Apparatus Entry at Target Wording: None
11
.
Exact Apparatus Information: No apparatus entry occurs for verse 3 (the notes at the base of page 317 record variants for 3:22, 25, 26, 28, 29, 30, 31, and 4:1, 4:2)
11
.
What the Apparatus Entry Does and Does Not Establish:
Does establish: Unanimous agreement among the four collated primary critical editions (Westcott–Hort, Tregelles, NIV, and Robinson–Pierpont) on the printed wording of Romans 4:3
11
.
Does not establish: Any textual doubt, manuscript divergence, or discussion concerning the citation formula or the intertextual relationship to Genesis 15:6
11
.
2. B001-2: Romans 9:25 / Hosea 2:23
Status: TEXT_PRESENT
2
.
Exact Passage / Reference: Πρὸς Ῥωμαίους (Romans) 9:25
2
.
Exact Printed Text: ὡς καὶ ἐν τῷ Ὡσηὲ λέγει· Καλέσω τὸν οὐ λαόν μου λαόν μου καὶ τὴν οὐκ ἠγαπημένην ἠγαπημένην·
2
Printed Page / Locator: Page 326
3
.
Apparatus Entry at Target Wording: None
3
.
Exact Apparatus Information: No entry is present for verse 25
3
.
What the Apparatus Entry Does and Does Not Establish:
Does establish: Complete consensus among the four reference editions (WH, Treg, NIV, RP) regarding the Greek text of Romans 9:25
3
.
Does not establish: Any text-critical variation or analysis of the Septuagintal or Masoretic phrasing of Hosea 2:23
3
.
3. B001-3: Romans 9:26 / Hosea 1:10
Status: TEXT_PRESENT
2
.
Exact Passage / Reference: Πρὸς Ῥωμαίους (Romans) 9:26
2
.
Exact Printed Text: καὶ ἔσται ἐν τῷ τόπῳ οὗ ἐρρέθη ⸀αὐτοῖς· Οὐ λαός μου ὑμεῖς, ἐκεῖ κληθήσονται υἱοὶ θεοῦ ζῶντος.
2
Printed Page / Locator: Page 326
3
.
Apparatus Entry at Target Wording: Yes (attached to ⸀αὐτοῖς)
2
3
.
Exact Apparatus Information: 26 αὐτοῖς WH NIV RP ] – Treg
3
.
What the Apparatus Entry Does and Does Not Establish:
Does establish: A textual variation unit on whether the dative pronoun αὐτοῖς belongs in the introductory clause; Holmes prints αὐτοῖς with WH, NIV, and RP, against Tregelles, who omits it
2
3
.
Does not establish: Any variation within the citation proper (Οὐ λαός μου ὑμεῖς...), nor any editorial commentary addressing the synthesis with Hosea 1:10
2
3
.
4. B001-4: Romans 10:11 / Isaiah 28:16
Status: TEXT_PRESENT
3
.
Exact Passage / Reference: Πρὸς Ῥωμαίους (Romans) 10:11
3
.
Exact Printed Text: λέγει γὰρ ἡ γραφή· Πᾶς ὁ πιστεύων ἐπʼ αὐτῷ οὐ καταισχυνθήσεται.
3
Printed Page / Locator: Page 327
14
.
Apparatus Entry at Target Wording: None
14
.
Exact Apparatus Information: No apparatus note occurs at verse 11 (the page apparatus treats verses 5, 9, 14, 15, 17, and 19)
14
.
What the Apparatus Entry Does and Does Not Establish:
Does establish: Unanimous consensus across WH, Treg, NIV, and RP for the Greek text of Romans 10:11
14
.
Does not establish: Any textual doubt or discussion regarding Paul's universalizing addition of Πᾶς relative to Isaiah 28:16
14
.

Status: TEXT_PRESENT
3
.
Exact Passage / Reference: Πρὸς Ῥωμαίους (Romans) 10:13
3
.
Exact Printed Text: Πᾶς γὰρ ὃς ἂν ἐπικαλέσηται τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου σωθήσεται.

14
.
Apparatus Entry at Target Wording: None

Exact Apparatus Information: No entry is present for verse 13

14
.
Does not establish: Any variant or discussion concerning the quotation of Joel 2:32 (LXX Joel 3:5)
14
.

Status: TEXT_PRESENT

.

15
.

4
15

4
15
.

Does establish: Complete consensus of the four primary critical editions on the Greek text of Romans 11:34
4

.
Does not establish: Any text-critical disagreement or commentary on the relationship to Isaiah 40:13 (or Job 41:3)
4
15

Status: TEXT_PRESENT
5
.
Exact Passage / Reference: Πρὸς Ῥωμαίους (Romans) 15:12
5
.
Exact Printed Text: καὶ πάλιν Ἠσαΐας λέγει· Ἔσται ἡ ῥίζα τοῦ Ἰεσσαί, καὶ ὁ ἀνιστάμενος ἄρχειν ἐθνῶν· ἐπʼ αὐτῷ ἔθνη ἐλπιοῦσιν.

5
.
Apparatus Entry at Target Wording: None
5
.
Exact Apparatus Information: No apparatus entry is present for verse 12
5
.

Does establish: Universal agreement among WH, Treg, NIV, and RP on the printed Greek text of Romans 15:12
5
.
Does not establish: Any textual doubt or discussion regarding the quotation of Isaiah 11:10
5
.

Status: TEXT_PRESENT
6
.
Exact Passage / Reference: Πρὸς Κορινθίους Α (1 Corinthians) 1:19
6
.
Exact Printed Text: γέγραπται γάρ· Ἀπολῶ τὴν σοφίαν τῶν σοφῶν, καὶ τὴν σύνεσιν τῶν συνετῶν ἀθετήσω.
6
Printed Page / Locator: Page 339
16
17

Apparatus Entry at Target Wording: None
16
17
.
Exact Apparatus Information: No apparatus note occurs at verse 19 (the apparatus on page 339 covers 1:20, 22, 23, 25, 27, 28, 30, and 2:1, 2, 4)
16
17
.

Does establish: Unanimous consensus across WH, Treg, NIV, and RP for the Greek text of 1 Corinthians 1:19
16
17
.
Does not establish: Textual variation or commentary concerning Isaiah 29:14
16
17
.
9. B001-9: 1 Corinthians 6:16 / Genesis 2:24
Status: TEXT_PRESENT
7
18

7
18
.
Exact Printed Text: ⸀ἢ οὐκ οἴδατε ὅτι ὁ κολλώμενος τῇ πόρνῃ ἓν σῶμά ἐστιν; Ἔσονται γάρ, φησίν, οἱ δύο εἰς σάρκα μίαν.
7
18
Printed Page / Locator: Page 344
7
.
Apparatus Entry at Target Wording: Yes (attached to the initial conjunction ⸀ἢ)
7
18
.
Exact Apparatus Information: 16 ἦ WH Treg NIV ] – RP
7
.

Does establish: A textual disagreement concerning whether the verse opens with the disjunctive particle ἦ (included by Holmes, WH, Tregelles, and NIV, but omitted by Robinson–Pierpont's Byzantine textform)
7
.
Does not establish: Any variation in the citation formula (Ἔσονται γάρ, φησίν) or the Genesis 2:24 citation text (οἱ δύο εἰς σάρκα μίαν), nor any expository evaluation of the quotation
7
18
.

Status: TEXT_PRESENT
9
.

9
.
Exact Printed Text: ἐν γὰρ τῷ Μωϋσέως νόμῳ γέγραπται· Οὐ ⸀κημώσεις βοῦν ἀλοῶντα. μὴ τῶν βοῶν μέλει τῷ θεῷ,
9
Printed Page / Locator: Page 349
13
.
Apparatus Entry at Target Wording: Yes (attached directly to ⸀κημώσεις)
9
13
.
Exact Apparatus Information: 9 κημώσεις Treg NIV ] φιμώσεις WH RP
13
.
What the Apparatus Entry Does and Does Not Establish:
Does establish: A textual variant in the prohibition from Deuteronomy 25:4, where Holmes adopts κημώσεις alongside Tregelles and NIV, rejecting the reading φιμώσεις supported by Westcott–Hort and the Byzantine textform (RP)
9
13
.
Does not establish: Any discussion of Paul's hermeneutical or allegorical argument regarding the support of apostles
9
13
.

Status: TEXT_PRESENT
10
.
Exact Passage / Reference: Πρὸς Κορινθίους Α (1 Corinthians) 10:7
10
.
Exact Printed Text: μηδὲ εἰδωλολάτραι γίνεσθε, καθώς τινες αὐτῶν· ὥσπερ γέγραπται· Ἐκάθισεν ὁ λαὸς φαγεῖν καὶ πεῖν, καὶ ἀνέστησαν παίζειν.
10
Printed Page / Locator: Page 350
19
.
Apparatus Entry at Target Wording: None
19
.
Exact Apparatus Information: No apparatus note occurs at verse 7 (the page apparatus covers 9:21, 22, 23 and 10:1, 2, 3, 4, 9, 10, 11)
19
.
What the Apparatus Entry Does and Does Not Establish:
Does establish: Unanimous agreement across WH, Treg, NIV, and RP on the Greek wording of 1 Corinthians 10:7
19
.
Does not establish: Any textual doubt or commentary concerning the citation of Exodus 32:6
10
19
.
12. B001-12: Galatians 3:13 / Deuteronomy 21:23
Status: TEXT_PRESENT
8
.
Exact Passage / Reference: Πρὸς Γαλάτας (Galatians) 3:13
8
.
Exact Printed Text: Χριστὸς ἡμᾶς ἐξηγόρασεν ἐκ τῆς κατάρας τοῦ νόμου γενόμενος ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν κατάρα, ⸂ὅτι γέγραπται⸃· Ἐπικατάρατος πᾶς ὁ κρεμάμενος ἐπὶ ξύλου,
8
Printed Page / Locator: Page 382
12
.
Apparatus Entry at Target Wording: Yes (attached to the introductory formula ⸂ὅτι γέγραπται⸃)
8
12
.
Exact Apparatus Information: 13 ὅτι γέγραπται WH Treg NIV ] γέγραπται γάρ RP
12
.
What the Apparatus Entry Does and Does Not Establish:
Does establish: A textual variation unit in the introductory citation formula, where Holmes prints ὅτι γέγραπται with WH, Tregelles, and NIV, while Robinson–Pierpont (RP) reads γέγραπται γάρ
8
12
.
Does not establish: Any variation in the curse clause itself (Ἐπικατάρατος πᾶς ὁ κρεμάμενος ἐπὶ ξύλου), nor any commentary on Deuteronomy 21:23
8
12
.
